Bug_Explanation: The bug is that the isInstance method is being used to check if one Class object is an instance of another Class object. This is incorrect as the isInstance method is used to check if an object is an instance of a class, not if a Class object is an instance of another Class object. The correct method to use in this case is the isAssignableFrom method.
